geometry_basis: 200-event hit audit plus eta_max=3: endcap inner radius = 2500/sinh(3). Effective fast-simulation surface, not a detailed ECAL layout.
sigma_definition: Gaussian standard deviation per orthogonal tangent-plane angular component; small-angle radial RMS = sqrt(2)*sigma
hit_anchor: intersection of origin-based reconstructed photon direction with the active surface
position_response: Inherited from existing reconstructed direction; no additional position smearing
selection: Diagnostic only; existing Stage 1 and BDT selections are not recomputed
